name: Crates and Treasure
description: Crates you can reel in, treasure and Neptunium.

pages.title: Crates and Treasure
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- Now and then a **crate** flies out of the water and lands as a block; open it like a barrel.
- Crates and the best treasure need **open water**.
- **Neptune's Bounty** is how you find Neptunium.
- Magnetic Bait brings far more crates.

**Wooden Crates** change with where you fish: fresh or salt water at the surface, underground (y0 to y40) or deep (below y0, with diamonds). Each holds 6 to 10 stacks and a Fishy Note.\
\
**Obsidian Crates** come from lava, **Purpur Crates** from The End (shulker shells and End loot; the Elytra they used to hold are shulker shells here).

**Hybrid Aquatic crates** and crab pots come up too. Break them with an **axe** for their loot.\
\
Other treasure: name tags, saddles, enchanted books and gear, Neptunium nuggets, leeches, and Critters and Companions' clams in rivers. Ocean monuments, trial chambers and desert wells have their own catches.

pages.title: Neptune's Bounty
pages.text: A rare open-water chest. Under the sea junk is Neptunium: 1 to 4 ingots, or a Neptunium tool, armor piece, bow or fillet knife.

pages.title: Neptunium
pages.text: Aquaculture's sea metal for tools, armor and a bow. Nuggets also come up as treasure; 9 make an ingot.
